name: figma_find_components
description: Find and inspect components, component sets, variants, and component property definitions in the active Figma file without flooding LLM context. Returns names, variant values, keys, and IDs.

include_variants.description: Whether to collect and return all available variant property keys and values (default: true)

limit.description: Maximum number of components to return to prevent token bloat (default: 30)

page_name.description: Optional page name filter (e.g. '🎨 Design System' or 'Components')

query.description: Search query to filter components by name, description, or variant name (optional, if empty returns all top components)
